g.text: AA06 - Administrator Role and Account Status Change
change roles, deactivate, or reactivate selected account
current actor User, active status, current roles
[actor is inactive or no longer an Administrator]
rollback (authorization changed while waiting for the lock)
target User, active status, roles, everActivated
[role removal or deactivation would leave zero active Administrators]
Adding a role to an existing account changes its role set only.
It does not trigger activation; the account's activation state
remains unchanged and activate() is not called.
Activation is required when a new local account is created, before it becomes
active. Adding another role to an existing account does not trigger activation.
